name: Blooming Gardens
source:
Blooming Gardens is an adult NSFW furry Visual Novel about love, identity and sexual exploration. Different paths, different romantic interests and different stories that tackle complex and challenging topics, all of which stems from a seemingly superficial decision.

The main character of this story is Amias, a college freshman who just started a new chapter of his life after moving to a new town for his University studies, and who despite the challenges of a new start, is set on carving a path into his future. 

After briefly being welcomed by his old childhood friend to this new life in a new city, an unexpected present from him will set Amias for a very interesting first night in town. However the surprises don't end there, and soon our protagonist will find himself confronted with the results of what he did last night, in ways he could have never predicted.

[From [url=https://chubbybunstudio.itch.io/blooming-gardens]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《盛开的花园》是一部关于爱情、身份和性探索的成人NSFW毛茸茸视觉小说。不同的道路、不同的爱情兴趣和不同的故事，解决复杂且具有挑战性的话题，所有这一切都源于一个看似肤浅的决定。

这个故事的主角是阿米亚斯，一名大学新生，搬到新的城镇上大学后刚刚开始了人生的新篇章，尽管新的开始充满了挑战，但他仍决心开辟自己的未来之路。

在受到儿时老友在新城市的新生活的短暂欢迎后，他送来的一份意想不到的礼物将使阿米亚斯在城里度过一个非常有趣的第一个晚上。然而惊喜并没有就此结束，很快我们的主角就会发现自己面临着昨晚所做的事情的结果，以他从未预料到的方式。

[来自[url=https://chubbybunstudio.itch.io/blooming-gardens]Itch.io[/url]]
